caveats: Subset read from daily files; baseline pool uses calendar windows (+-5 d) incl. 1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05; non-sea cells (NaN on some target day) set to 0; grid coordinates are float32 values from dataset cast to float64. Some daily files listing was capped at 1000 but all needed files were accessed directly. The single event starts on 2013-06-01, the first target day, so it may have begun earlier (left-censored by the target window; pre-window SST was not used).
